notes: Use a synthetic owner. Do not type real contractor details, rates, or notes into logs or PR text.

features.name: Create owner account
features.reach: Open /sign-up, submit name, email, and password.

features.name: Empty week
features.reach: Sign in and stay on the current week before adding shifts.
features.expect: The heading 'No shifts this week' is visible. Copy week brief still copies a zero total.

features.name: Record a shift
features.reach: Add a site, add a contractor, assign them, then use the shift sheet.
features.expect: The week grid shows the shift. Contractor pay uses the snapshotted rate.

features.name: Pay by site
features.reach: Record shifts at two sites, then read the payment summary.
features.expect: By site lists each site's hours and gross pay. The site cents sum to the contractor total.

features.name: Copy week brief
features.reach: Press Copy week brief on a week that has shifts.
features.expect: A status message says the brief was copied. The text has contractor lines, site lines, and a total, and it has no rates or email addresses.

features.name: Approve week
features.reach: Press Approve week and confirm the totals.
features.expect: The week badge says Approved and shift edits are refused until reopen.
